title: Secretary of State Marco Rubio speaks with Panamanian President José Raúl Mulino
excerpt: The discussion addressed earthquake recovery efforts and the upcoming UN Secretary General election.
bodyHtml:
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio held a call with Panamanian President José Raúl Mulino on October 27, 2026. The conversation focused on recovery efforts following the October 9 earthquake in Panama and discussed regional issues alongside the UN Secretary General election.

According to the US State Department, the United States provided humanitarian, logistics, communication, and technical assistance to affected communities within 24 hours of the earthquake. This aid included food, water, and urban search and rescue teams.

The US State Department reported that the call reaffirmed the deepening U.S.-Panama partnership following the October 9 earthquake. Secretary Rubio emphasized that the American people will continue to stand firmly with Panama through its recovery.

The United States noted that its strong relationship with Panama allowed for the delivery of assistance to affected communities within 24 hours.
